reason: The patch itself adds Javadoc describing what each new scope grants (services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/services/resources/admin/permissions/GroupPermissionEvaluator.java, patch lines 374-396 for MANAGE_MEMBERS, MANAGE_MEMBERSHIP, VIEW_MEMBERS), and the admin console already carries descriptions for the type and scopes (js/apps/admin-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v2/admin/messages/messages_en.properties:3351, 3413-3417). No .adoc guide covers the V2 Groups type, but none covers the V2 Users or Clients types either and the feature is EXPERIMENTAL (common/src/main/java/org/keycloak/common/Profile.java:58).
